instructions.text: Dans un shaker rempli de glaçons, verser tous les alcools puis compléter avec les jus de fruits.
Shaker pendant 2-3 minutes, jusqu'à ce que les glaçons disparaissent.
Servir dans un grand verre à cocktail, type "verre tulipe".

decisions.note: Yield in glasses: 'verre' is in R-12's closed list, since a cocktail is sold by the glass, so servings is 1.
No cooking: the header writes '-' and the JSON-LD writes PT0S for the same page, so the value is 0, not null (Q-07).

decisions.line: 3 cl de vodka, 4 cl de jus d'ananas, 4 cl de jus de cranberries, 2 cl de crème de mûre, 2 cl de sirop de melon
decisions.note: Every volume converted from centilitres to millilitres. Names are kept as sold: 'jus de cranberries' keeps its plural, since juice is what is bought and no cranberry is counted.
